blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.detail: Easy swings, 58° and 54°. No score.

blocks.title: Chart
blocks.detail: Half, three-quarter and full, 4 balls each, with the 54° and the 58°.

blocks.title: Ladder
blocks.detail: 40 to 130 yards in 10-yard steps, 2 balls each, choosing the club yourself, plus 1 more at your worst distance. Don't move the green: read the carry against your number.

blocks.title: Test
blocks.detail: Test Center, 40 to 135 yards in 5-yard steps, one ball each, random order if offered, full routine.

note: Sunday wedges. Block 4 is the number to track. Take a photo of the final score screen and send it to me: I cannot yet confirm that score reaches me on its own. The first 4 Sundays set your baseline.

focus: 0-50 yd short game, Approach 75-150 yd, Driving penalties

blocks.title: Warmup
blocks.detail: 9-iron, loose. No targets.

blocks.title: Technical: Pause at the top (Harmon)
blocks.detail: 8-iron only. Swing to the top, stop, then hit the shot. Every ball.

blocks.title: Driver corridor (leak 1)
blocks.detail: 36 yd fairway on screen. Full routine every ball. This is the shot that costs you most.

blocks.title: Approach 75 to 150 yd (leak 2)
blocks.detail: Alternate 75, 112 and 150 yd to a green-sized target. Change club every ball; never hit the same number twice running.

blocks.title: Pressure test
blocks.detail: Random distances 60–180, one ball each, full routine. Miss the target and the last three repeat.

note: Synced TrackMan sessions import within the hour after you finish. Keep a bay CSV only as a fallback if the session does not sync. Don’t count or judge anything mid-session.

blocks.title: Driver corridor (leak 1)
blocks.detail: 36 yd fairway on screen. Full routine every ball. This is the shot that costs you most, so it gets the most balls.

note: Export the CSV when you leave and send it to me. Don’t count or judge anything mid-session.

A measurement session, not a practice one: 5 clubs never measured. Full swings at one target, same ball, and read the median rather than your best. 40 balls, scoring clubs first, so the clubs that set your approach yardages are done even if you stop early. What comes out of it is a carry table you can trust on the course. Already measured: 50°, 54°, 58°, 7i, 8i, 9i, Dr, Pw.
